AuterionOS

# Operate a connected robotics fleet

AuterionOS is the only vendor-independent operating system that runs onboard a fleet of interconnected robots.

[Included in every Skynode and select partner manufacturers free of charge](https://auterion.com/product/auterion-os/)

## What AuterionOS can do?

AuterionOS is the brain of the autonomous robot - a complete onboard software platform that turns hardware into a mission-ready system.

It doesn’t just fly the drone. It runs the operation.

From advanced autonomy and real-time communications to seamless integration with sensors, payloads, and third-party software, AuterionOS gives you a reliable, secure foundation to execute complex missions at scale.

Deploy new capabilities as easily as installing an app.

Connect your robot to the cloud over LTE.

Operate with confidence in the most demanding environments.

This is how you move from manual flights to fully autonomous operations — faster, safer, and with the flexibility to adapt to whatever comes next.

## Delivery to 4 Million U.S. Households in Partnership with DroneUp

Powered By AuterionOS

AuterionOS powers the drone fleet that operates in the delivery hubs of the largest American retailer to provide 4 million U.S. households with last-mile delivery.

[Learn more on DroneUp.com](https://www.droneup.com/2022/05/24/delivery-4-million-us-households-partnership-walmart)

### Benefits Overview

## AuterionOS is the operating system for flexible robotics deployment

$

#### Flexibility of choice

Operate a variety of vehicles and payloads with the same experience and workflow. Use APIs to expand the range of cameras, radios and payloads

$

#### Safe deployments and real-time monitoring

Always deploy your fleet safely with automated pre-flight checks, over-the-air updates and automated flight analysis for predictive maintenance

$

#### Efficient data workflows

Cloud connectivity enables automated data workflow from the field to your office, facilitating remote collaboration and decision making

$

#### Use-case specific automation at hand

Access the App store and deploy a variety of apps from Auterion or from 3rd party developers, that maximise the use of autonomous robots

$

#### Simplified compliance

Get automated flight logging and reporting analytics, keep track of your pilots training, comply with FAA rules including [Remote ID](https://auterion.com/remote-id/)
